$comment: What the skills in this repo call. install.sh reads this file. 'required' is installed by default; 'optional' only with --with-optional.

required.name: grilling
required.why: /work 中、大需求开工前一次性把决策问清楚

required.name: code-review
required.why: 每个 PR 交给人之前做一次新上下文的审查

optional.name: agent-browser
optional.why: UI 改动的截图和无头浏览器检查

optional.name: chrome-use
optional.why: 需要用你已登录的 Chrome 检查页面时

required.name: gh
required.install: brew install gh && gh auth login

optional.name: herdr
optional.why: /work 大需求时自动开主控 tab；没有时打印命令让你手动开

optional.name: lsof
optional.why: 会话清点脚本 sessions.sh 用它找进程目录（macOS 自带）
